fieldProvenance.champions.*.pickRate: provider build page header, 'Pick Rate' (share of games; see units)
fieldProvenance.champions.*.dataDate: provider build page header, 'Data date' (observation date)
fieldProvenance.champions.*.augments[].winRate: provider 'Win rate' on the champion's listed row; see semantics
fieldProvenance.champions.*.items: provider item sections; win rate counts only games that completed the path

appearanceRate.note: The provider does not define 'pick rate' or 'appearance rate'. Global augment pick rates sum to about 3,450% over all live augments, which fits a share of GAMES (10 players, about 3.4 augments each) like the champion pick rate, but that is a hypothesis. Keep the unlisted-pair subtraction off (unit guard) until confirmed.

pickRate.meaning: share of games the champion appears in
pickRate.confirmation: champion pick rates sum to 1000% across all champions (10 players per game); scripts/validate_stats_feeds.py re-checks the sum on every run
